# Callouts: Recovery 2.3 - the clip on U8: reading the LaunchPad's flash

Source: Own photo, raptox's LaunchPad, 2026-11-05  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec2-3_launchpad-u8-clip.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec2-3_launchpad-u8-clip.jpg)

RESET held for the whole read. The clip on U8 with its pin-1 lead at the dot. CS, SO, SI, SCLK and GND to the 3.3 V reader; the clip's VCC lead stays off (the LaunchPad's own USB powers the flash).
